overview:
The *Tikkunei Zohar* says that when G-d leaves the vessels they are left like a body without a soul. But if a vessel is made from the thickening of the light, how can it be there without the light? Because, as chapter 29 showed, the root of the vessels, in the *reshimu*, comes before the root of the lights: the vessels exist on their own, and G-d is one with them because He chose them. So in prayer one can aim at the source of the vessel, and the light follows. Rabbi Walters sets this beside the other ways of *kavana*, and says the main one is still to *daven* like a little kid.

Every vessel has an inner, a middle and an outer level, for intellect, emotion and action, and the outer one hides the most. He shows it in a man's kindness, in the heart, in the liver, in the exile, and in the *mitzvos*: *kavana*, feeling and deed, made to grow by doing them only because G-d wants it. Yet the vessels are there for the light; without it they are a body without a soul.

terms.gloss: a body without a soul: the vessels, brain, heart and liver, once the lights leave them
thickening: the lowest level of the light, brought down, makes the form of the vessel
He and His organs are one: the vessels come straight from G-d's choice, even before the lights
the middle: the middle vessel, between the inner (pnimiyus) and the outer (chitzoniyus), which limits the emotions of the light
head, middle and end: the three levels of the vessels; read backwards their initials spell seser, hidden
the vessels that bring the light out to someone else, as against the vessels that reveal it to oneself
garments: thought, speech and action, which change like clothes; below the vessels and already separate from G-dliness
the impression of life: what is left in the liver in sleep, the source of dreams; in exile, all that is seen of G-d's running of the world
pregnancy: the Jewish people in exile, like a fetus with its head folded between its knees
the kindnesses that make the body grow: the general G-dly light of every mitzva, doing what G-d wants
yichud, bracha, kedusha: the kavana, blessing and deed of a mitzva; also the name of a river

sections.title: The vessels exist on their own: a body without a soul
sections.summary: The *Tikkunei Zohar* says that vessels the light has left are like a body without a soul. Since a vessel is made from the thickening of the light, that raises a question; the answer is that the root of the vessels comes before the root of the lights, so the vessels have an existence of their own and come straight from G-d's choice.

blocks.text:
The last three chapters explained lights and vessels: the *or* (light) coming into the *kli* (vessel) goes from spiritual to physical and becomes limited.

In a more particular *hisbonenus* (contemplation), *ihu v'chayohi chad*, *ihu v'garmohi chad*: G-d is one with the vessels as with the lights, because the limitation and the vessel come from His *bechira* (choice). The vessels are revealed as limited, but since the limitation is His choice, it too is one with Him: "its only existence is G-d's choice."

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: A cup for the water
blocks.text: The vessels come from the *hisabus* (thickening) of the light: its lowest level, brought down, makes the form of the vessel. A person wants to drink water but cannot hold it in his hand, so from that desire comes the form of a cup, waterproof, able to hold it. So too the eye is made as it must be to see.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Now we can understand the *Tikkunei Zohar* in *Pasach Eliyahu*, said every week: when You leave the vessels, the names, they are *gufa b'lo nishmasa*, a body without a soul. The body is **the vessels of the brain, the heart, and the liver**; the soul, the *oros* (lights) of *nefesh*, *ruach* and *neshama*.

blocks.question: The vessel is created by the thickening of the light. How can it be there once the light leaves it?
blocks.text: By the previous chapter, **the source of the vessels precedes the source of the lights**: the vessels come from the *reshimu* (impression), which is before the *Kav* (the ray of light), the source of the lights. So the vessels have an existence of their own, independent of the light.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So it says *ihu v'garmohi chad*: **G-d is one with His organs, He is one with the vessels**. Lights and vessels both come from the *etzem* (essence), His choice. The source of the vessels is revealed first, in the *reshimu*, and the lights after, so the vessels come straight from the essence with no light in between.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So the matter of the vessel precedes the light. The light only makes its form, and even the form really exists without it: "The light is just choosing which form it should take on."

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: The body does not turn back into dirt
blocks.text: The soul controls the body and shapes its form, but when it leaves, the body does not lose its form at once or turn straight back into dirt: it has a certain existence without the soul.

sections.title: Aiming at the source of the vessel, and praying like a little kid
sections.summary: So one who is *mechaven* in the Name should aim at the source that creates the vessel, and the light follows by itself. Rabbi Walters sets the ways of *kavana* of chapters 28 to 30 side by side, and says the main one is still the simple prayer of a child, who pictures G-d and does not limit Him.

phrases.en: you should be *mechaven* to the source that creates the *kli*,

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So when you *daven* and are *mechaven* (direct your intention) to the names, **you should be *mechaven* to the source that creates the *kli***. That is the main thing of the name, *ihu v'garmohi chad*: G-d chooses the vessels and how they are, and so they are a name.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Recognize that G-d chooses the vessel and it reveals Him, and the light comes by itself, "because it's the way of a man *lachazor achar isha*, to go after a woman": have the *kli*, the woman, and the *or*, the man, will come. *V'dai l'mevin* (and this is enough for one who understands).

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So far: chapter 28 says to be *mechaven* to the source of the lights, and the vessel comes automatically; chapter 29, to the external vessels, and their source comes automatically; here, to the source of the vessels, and the light comes too. The *kavanos* here and in 28 are in parentheses and 29's are not, because 29 is the simple *pshat* (plain meaning) of how to *daven*.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text:
*Daven* like a little kid: ask G-d for what you want, in the vessel you want, food and health, knowing He gives them. That is the external vessel.

Higher is to be *mechaven* to the light, wanting really *gilui Elokus* (a revelation of G-dliness). Then you become a *kli* and a *merkava* (chariot) for G-dliness, and you automatically get everything good *b'gashmiyus* (materially) too.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Here he says to be *mechaven* to the source of the vessel: G-d can make it come out any way, and you ask Him to make it come out this way, as a revelation of Him, so it brings out the light. You want G-d revealed tangibly, and so you want it in a vessel: a higher way of *davening*.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The two ways in parentheses are a deeper *kavana*. Still, the main *kavana* is chapter 29's: *daven* like a kid, *al daas zeh hatinok*, "I pray with the mind of this little child," as the Rebbe said of himself and the *Gemara* says too. *Daven* like that and you have all the other *kavanos* automatically.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The deeper type is hidden in the simple way a kid *davens*. He may picture G-d as an invisible man with a long white beard, but does not really think G-d is a person or limit Him. When G-d took us out of Egypt with a *yad rama* or a *yad chazaka* (an uplifted or a strong hand), he pictures a hand picking us up, yet does not think G-d is limited to a body. G-d can do anything, "it's magic": He chose to do it so, and it does not limit Him.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: An adult picturing even the highest thing, *Adam Kadmon*, thinks he understands what G-d is and limits Him to it; and it says that limiting G-d even to *Adam Kadmon* is so close to *avoda zara* (idol worship) that you can already call it that. A little kid's idea of G-d is so close to the truth that "you can *mamash* call it the truth."

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Still, we should know these types of *davening*. The *Arizal* said to be *mechaven* to the light within the *sefiros*, not the vessels; the *Baal Shem Tov*, to the G-dliness within the *sefiros*, not just the light; and the *Alter Rebbe*: "But I say that you should be *mechaven* to the *Atzmus*" (G-d's essence). Be like a little kid, and you have everything.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: In the back of your mind, learn how lights and vessels work and how they are *gilui Elokus*; it helps you be *mechaven* to the essence. But do not focus on these *kavanos* for themselves. The best thing, in *davening* and in life, is to be *mechaven* to G-d simply and straight, like a little kid; the learning is there to reveal that *emuna* (faith), not for *tachbulos* (schemes) and calculations.

audio.lecture: 62 - Chap- 30-1 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

sections.title: Three levels of vessels, and why G-d is hidden in the outer one
sections.summary: The vessels have an inside, a middle and an outside, which limit the intellect, the emotions and the action of the light. The word *seser*, hidden, is *rosh toch sof* backwards: the main concealment is in the outer vessel, where a person, and G-d in nature, is seen only by what was done.

phrases.en: there's three levels in the *kelim*:

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: the inner *kelim*, the middle *kelim*, and the outer *kelim*.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: the idea is known,

phrases.en: that corresponding to the three groups, the three triads of *Chabad*, *Chagas*, *Nehi*, the *sechel*, the emotions, and the impulse to act upon the emotion, there's three types of *kelim* that correspond to these three levels.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: פנימית הכלים הוא בחינת הגבלת האור דחב''ד שבאור

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: and the middle *kelim* is what limits the emotions of the *or*,

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: and the external vessels is what limits and brings out the *Nehi*, the external expression of the light.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The *kelim* (vessels) have three levels, *pnimiyus*, *emtzaiyus* and *chitzoniyus*: inner, middle and outer. They match the three triads, *Chabad*, *Chagas* and *Nehi*: the *sechel* (intellect), the emotions, and the impulse to act on them. The inner vessels limit the *Chabad* within the light, the middle its emotions, and the outer bring out the *Nehi*, **the external expression of the light**.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: and this is what it says, that You, *Hashem*, are hidden.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שעיקר ההגבלה וההסתר בחיצוניות הכלים כו'
phrases.en: because the main limitation and the main concealment is in the *chitzoniyus* of the *kelim*, the external vessels, which is the *sof*.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So it says *atah seser*: You, G-d, are hidden. *Seser*, *samech*, *tav*, *reish*, read backwards is *reish*, *tav*, *samech*, the initials of *rosh toch sof* (head, middle and end): the inside hidden in the middle and the middle in the outside. **The main limitation and the main concealment is in the *chitzoniyus* of the *kelim***, the *sof*.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: Seeing only what a person did
blocks.text: When a person does or says something, you mainly see the external thing he did, usually not even how he feels about it. Put yourself in his shoes and you would understand him better; get into his actual mind, better still. But once his expression comes out through the body's external vessels, his intellect and emotions are hidden, and you just see what happened.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text:
So with G-d and the world. Run through external vessels, a system of *teva* (nature), the sun giving light for our *parnasa* (livelihood), wheat made into bread, G-dliness is very hidden, and we can say we do not need G-d, we have our wheat.

With the *mon* (manna) they felt the dependence, since it came each day and nothing was saved. A person with full storehouses easily thinks G-d can do nothing to him; he is set and no longer feels he depends on G-d. That is the external vessel.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Already in the middle vessel, *chesed*, which creates everything from nothing, you see it must come from somewhere. What mainly covers over G-dliness is calling it Mother Nature, as the scientists say it is a scientific thing, not from G-d. Really *teva* too is from G-d; they do not see that.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

sensitivity.reason: Says of scientists as a group that they call nature "a scientific thing, it's not from G-d".
sensitivity.publishable: Already in the middle vessel, *chesed*, which creates everything from nothing, you see it must come from somewhere. What mainly covers over G-dliness is calling it Mother Nature, as people say, not from G-d. Really *teva* too is from G-d; they do not see that.

blocks.text: Where the world originally came from, they cannot hide: G-d must have created it. All they can say is that it was a really long time ago, the Big Bang, they do not know how, only what happened after, and they are not so sure of that either. But in an external vessel like nature, it is much more hidden.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

sections.title: Vessels that reveal to oneself, and vessels that bring it out to others
sections.summary: A vessel reveals the light to oneself, as the brain, heart and liver do; the *tikunim* bring it out to someone else. These too have an inner, middle and outer level, for intellect, emotion and deed.

phrases.he: וגם בענין מה שיש בכלי בחינת השפעת וירידת השפע למקבל דוקא כנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: also in the *inyan* of the *kelim* that they bring the *or* down to a *mekabel*,

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: So this *inyan* of the *kelim* also has three levels: the inner, the middle, and the external *kli*.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The vessels also bring the light down to a *mekabel* (receiver). As explained before, a vessel has two *inyanim* (matters), *kelim* and *tikunim*; a *kli* as such just reveals the light to yourself.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Your brain is a vessel for your soul to reveal its intellect to itself: an idea in your brain, and you know clearly what you think. Your heart reveals your emotions to you, changing how it beats and how your lungs breathe. Your liver, the whole digestive system, gives you physical life, so your soul can relate to the physical world.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Then there are vessels to bring it out to the outside world. With your soul in your brain you can explain an idea to somebody; in your heart, express the emotion and want to do things for him; through your liver you have the *koach hamaaseh* (the power of action) to do them. These external vessels are *tikunim*, and they too are inner, middle and outer.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: פנימית הכלי הוא בחינת הבאת אור שפע דחב''ד
phrases.en: The inner vessel is what brings over the light and the *shefa* of the *Chabad*, of the intellect.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: the middle *kli* is to bring over the emotions, the feelings.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

phrases.en: and the external vessel is to bring over the *maaseh*, the final thing you want to do, based on your intellect and emotions.

audio.lecture: 63 - Chap- 30-2 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **The inner vessel is what brings over the light and the *shefa* of the *Chabad*, of the intellect**, to express it to others. The middle vessel brings over the emotions, and the outer the *maaseh* (deed), what you finally do from intellect and emotions.

sections.summary: A man's kindness has its own intellect, love and power of action, and each has its own vessel: thought, speech and deed. But thought, speech and action are really *levushim*, garments that change; the vessels proper, which are one with G-d, are the brain, the heart and the liver.

sections.title: Why a vessel without the light is a body without a soul
sections.summary: Even with a root of their own, the brain, heart and liver need the light of the *Kav* to reveal G-d, as a body shows its life by moving. And since the whole purpose of a vessel is to bring out the light, without it the vessel is a body without a soul: it does not spread or grow.

blocks.text: The vessels have their own source, so they can exist without the *Kav*. But the *Kav* changes them, and the changes reveal the essence, the light. In the body, what shows it is alive is movement, the blood circulating, the heart pumping, and more, a person moving consciously, doing what he wants and responding. So the names, the vessels, exist, but need the *Kav* to reveal G-d, to show they are run by His *ratzon* (will) and His *bechira*.

blocks.question: If the vessels have their own source, higher than the lights, why make a big fuss about what is not the main thing, and say that without the light they are like a body without a soul?
blocks.text: The main thing of the vessels is to correspond to the nine *sefiros* of *nefesh*, *ruach* and *neshama*; that is their whole purpose. The brain is to express the *neshama*, the intellect; the heart, the emotions; the liver, the physical life. Without the light the vessel has no purpose.

audio.lecture: 66 - Chap- 30-5 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: And as the light increases, the vessel increases. Why? The vessel wants to bring over the light, and a greater light needs a greater vessel, **in order to bring the light out below**: that is the vessel's whole purpose.

audio.lecture: 66 - Chap- 30-5 Pnimius Emztous and Chitzonius of Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: If the light leaves, **then the vessel is left like a body without a soul**: it will not spread or grow, and no life is seen in it. Its whole purpose is to reveal G-dliness; without that it has no purpose, and G-d's *ratzon* no longer goes into it to keep it growing and animated. That is enough to understand.
